sources.claim: Virtual influencer market valued at $6.1B in 2024, projected to grow from $11.8B in 2026 to $45.9B by 2030 at a 40.8% CAGR
Virtual Influencer Market to reach $298 billion by 2035, growing at 38.54% CAGR; ByteDance, Soul Machines, Kuki AI among key players
Virtual influencer market $8.3B in 2025; virtual influencer engagement rates average 5.67% vs 1.89% for human creators; 58% of consumers follow at least one virtual influencer
2026 Creator Economy Report: 91.9% of creators now utilize at least one AI tool; virtual influencer market $11.74B in 2026
NY AI Transparency in Advertising Act signed December 11 2025, took effect June 9 2026; requires conspicuous disclosure for synthetic performers; $1,000 then $5,000 per violation
EU AI Act Article 50 synthetic content disclosure compliance required from August 2 2026; FTC Operation AI Comply 12+ enforcement actions targeting synthetic influencer content

65% of US consumers unlikely to buy products promoted by AI influencers without disclosure; FTC maximum civil penalty $53,088 per violation; Lu do Magalu drives $180M in attributed e-commerce sales in 2026
Brud (Lil Miquela) raised $131M total funding; Lil Miquela has roughly 3 million Instagram followers and partnerships with Prada, Calvin Klein, Samsung
Genies raised $276M total funding over 17 rounds from 76 investors; develops customizable intelligent characters and avatar SDK for creators and celebrities
High-end virtual influencer development costs $150K–$500K initial; $5K–$30K/month ongoing content production and community management
Global virtual influencer market worth $13.2B in 2026 growing at 41.5% CAGR to $424.8B by 2036 (alternate estimate); virtual influencer segment $11.74B by Business Research Company estimate

notes: Market size estimates vary between research firms ($11.74B to $13.2B for 2026) — all within same order of magnitude and directionally consistent
Growth rate (40.8% to 41.5% CAGR) consistent across multiple research firms
Market share figures for specific companies are estimated — no public breakdown found for exact share by company revenue
Environmental impact claim marked [unverified] — no peer-reviewed lifecycle comparison study for virtual vs. human influencer campaigns found
5Y growth estimate (+440%) derived from 40.8% CAGR extrapolation backward from 2026 to 2021; no direct 2021 market size source found
3M growth (+9%) derived from annualized quarterly rate at 40.8% CAGR — no direct Q-over-Q market data available
